scope: Only known manual source replay after authorized deletion; no blanket empty-customer or new source-mode gating

public_api.name: gridex_manual_inbound_source_retired_v1
public_api.access: service_role EXEC plus explicit auth.role guard

private_state: gridex_manual_inbound.retired_source_keys(source_key,retired_at); hash only, immutable UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE, RLS/service readonly
retirement: BEFORE DELETE stores only OLD stable key under same advisory transaction lock as INSERT/lookup; original source DELETE privileges/RLS untouched
direct_writer_guard: BEFORE INSERT retired exact key raises23514 MESSAGE manual_inbound_source_retired; VOLATILE SPI fresh snapshot after lock wait

pglite.red_actual_bug: After physical-source DELETE an otherwise identical raw INSERT succeeded before migration

tests.native_static: PostgreSQL17.5 exact source DDL/unique provider index, unchanged source grants/RLS, no existing-row retirement, own-delete vs foreign RLS denial, exact/fresh keys, double replay, private ACL, immutable owner-delete passed
tests.native_multi_connection: Separate local fixture, INSERT waited1.022seconds then23514; service lookup waited1.042seconds then true; raw rows0 both; VOLATILE post-wait visibility proved

limitations: Native policy is an owned-row fixture; authentic full-schema replay/type capture/live execution are root-owned. No live data/schema mutations by preparer.
